# @thednp/rpc

> A Vite plugin for creating server functions with automatic, type-safe RPC.

- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thednp/rpc): published package
- [JSR](https://jsr.io/@thednp/rpc): published package (Deno)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/thednp/rpc): source repository
- [Getting started](https://github.com/thednp/rpc/blob/master/wiki/getting-started.md): installation and first function
- [Server functions](https://github.com/thednp/rpc/blob/master/wiki/server-functions.md): createServerFunction API
- [Wire protocol](https://github.com/thednp/rpc/blob/master/wiki/wire-protocol.md): HTTP contract
- [Security](https://github.com/thednp/rpc/blob/master/wiki/security.md): hardening model
- [Best practices](https://github.com/thednp/rpc/blob/master/wiki/best-practices.md): production patterns
